name: wait_vblank_counter_ticks
purpose: Wait for a requested number of changes to the EEPROM/VBLANK long counter
arguments: tick count word in a long slot

name: display_text_set_cursor
purpose: Draw one string at explicit coordinates and update the operator-UI cursor to its end
arguments: coordinate0 low byte; coordinate1 low byte; string pointer

name: display_text_at_cursor
purpose: Draw one string at the saved operator-UI cursor and advance that cursor

name: display_decimal_at_cursor
purpose: Draw one trimmed eight-digit decimal value at the saved operator-UI cursor

name: display_decimal_set_cursor
purpose: Format an eight-digit zero-padded decimal, trim leading zeroes while retaining one digit, draw it at explicit coordinates, and update the cursor
arguments: coordinate0 low byte; coordinate1 low byte; value long

name: option_record_present
purpose: Test whether the first two bytes of an option descriptor record are both zero
return: D0.l = bitwise OR of record bytes 0 and 1 (zero means terminator)

name: find_option_record
purpose: Advance through a variable-length option-descriptor stream to one record index
return: D0.l = selected record pointer, or 0 at/past the terminator

name: render_option_record
purpose: Render one option descriptor's label and selected value, optionally clearing its prior effect
arguments: record pointer; current settings word; comparison/default word; display row word; style/clear flags word
return: D0.l = pointer to the following record, or 0 for a terminator

name: render_option_record_page
purpose: Find a starting option record and render one orientation-sized page of records
arguments: stream pointer; current settings word; comparison/default word; first record index word; style/clear flags word

name: display_next_screen_prompt
purpose: Draw the game-specific action label inside the OS 'Press ... for next screen' prompt

name: init_operator_mob_display
purpose: Install the eight-word operator-screen MOB template and clear its trailing link word

name: run_statistics_histograms
purpose: Display and navigate per-player difficulty histograms, with optional clearing

name: display_statistics_play_time
purpose: Sum stored play-time groups, scale large totals safely, and display total time plus active-time percentage
arguments: display row word in a long slot

name: run_statistics_summary
purpose: Display stored configuration/statistics counters and optionally clear the resettable counters

name: run_game_settings_bit_editor
purpose: Interactively edit the sixteen raw game-settings bits and store configuration item 12

name: draw_game_settings_bits
purpose: Draw all sixteen game-settings bits and highlight one selected bit
arguments: settings word in a long slot; selected bit index word in a long slot

name: run_statistics_screens
purpose: Initialize operator-screen MOBs, run the statistics summary, then run the histogram viewer

name: run_option_descriptor_editor
purpose: Render and interactively edit a variable-length option-descriptor stream
arguments: descriptor-stream pointer; current settings word; comparison/default settings word

name: run_game_options
purpose: Initialize the operator display and edit configuration item 12 through a descriptor stream or the raw-bit fallback
arguments: descriptor-stream pointer, or null for raw-bit editor
return: D0.l = observable delegated setting-writer result, not the edited word

name: run_coin_options
purpose: Initialize the operator display, edit configuration item 11 through the built-in coin-options stream, and store it
return: D0.l = observable delegated setting-writer result, not the edited word
